title: Fix Aggregator Window Right Borders
description: Aggregator: right borders of windows are not visible or very tiny. Active Perspective pane shows red borders on left/top/bottom but the right edge at the screen edge is missing/clipped. Fix so all four window borders render consistently and visibly.
summary:
Fixed missing/tiny right (and bottom) window silhouette borders.

**Cause:** `windowSilhouettePath` used a 0.5px inset for a centered 1px hairline SVG stroke, placing the stroke flush with the exclusive max clip edge of overflow-hidden ancestors. Left/top (inclusive min edges) stayed visible; right/bottom vanished.

**Fix:** Default inset is now `WINDOW_SILHOUETTE_PATH_INSET = 1` so the full hairline sits inside the stack box. Mode dock `ResizablePanel` also uses `overflow-visible`.

**Verified:** ui-react vitest filters for silhouette/Mode — 29 passed.
